gen-gf-bellota-gf-sn-pro: Bellota's s hangs its ends far out from the spine, and every stroke looks pulled through a nozzle at one width. SN Pro, in sans-serif form, gives that quirk a modern partner whose open curves keep everything easy to follow.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-snippet: Commanding is how Bellota looks, its stylus-width strokes and far-flung s making a bold, hand-traced statement. And Snippet, a sans with a wide crescent c and a wire-bent feel, carries a longer stretch of text in a friendly, approachable way.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-source-sans-3: Source Sans 3 has an a whose lower bowl opens up to breathe, giving the pair its modern, working tone. Nudge its size up a little.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-spinnaker: Marker-drawn plainness runs through every Bellota character, with an s whose ends hang well away from the spine. Spinnaker follows in a plain sans, its apertures keeping counters linked to the outside, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-stick:
Bellota draws every stroke at stylus width, ends of the s drifting outward.

Stick answers in a plain sans of tubelike, constant-weight lines whose wide exits let light through, so the quirky heading sits above a quietly modern text that never competes with it.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-suse: Rope-thick strokes, hand-traced. Bellota carries that look in its hanging s, while SUSE's open bowls tip toward you like a ladle, and a body size slightly larger than usual helps those friendly curves breathe.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tajawal: Wirelike and a bit wild, Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine. And Tajawal steps in with a sans whose c is a broad open hook, so the page moves from quirky heading to clean, tidy text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tasa-explorer: Bellota looks sketched by a pencil that never presses harder, its s ends drifting wide of the spine. But TASA Explorer, a clean sans with curves that stop like brush strokes lifted early, gives that sketch a friendly, approachable companion.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tasa-orbiter: Curves without any stress and an s with ends hung far from its spine make Bellota instantly recognizable. TASA Orbiter's sans-serif counters stay unclogged, so a slightly larger body size suits it.
